titulo: Me going to bed early tonight
caption:
Me going to bed early tonight

Me going to bed early tonight.

It was 9:58 and the plan was real. Then three more minutes became three hours.

Next time: put the phone to charge across the room before you sit down.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes sits on a bed looking down, with a digital clock on the wall reading 9:58. The clock creeps to 10:01, 10:04, 10:07 while the figure pulses softly and sways. In the last second the clock jumps to 1:07 and the text changes from: me going to bed early tonight, to: it's 1:07 AM. The figure's eyes go wide, then it narrows its eyes at the camera.
